sections.title: Truth rules
sections.body: - Never fabricate physical RF or GPU acceleration results. - Default host evidence is **CPU-only** (`SYNTHETIC_SIM`). - `make gate4-gpu` exits honestly with `BLOCKED_GPU` when CUDA is absent. - Do not claim “emergent language” without interpretability analysis (entropy, MI, topographic similarity, interventions).
